params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-runner-v2-clean'
if(Test-Path $tmp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force}
git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $tmp
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('git clone failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
$src=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner.ps1'
$text=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $src
$text=$text.Replace("$RunnerName = 'heaven'","$RunnerName = 'heaven-v2'")
$text=$text.Replace("'actions-runner-heaven'","'actions-runner-heaven-v2'")
$patched=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner-v2.ps1'
Set-Content -LiteralPath $patched -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
& $patched
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('runner installer failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
